svg.title: The recommended family for each process
svg.desc: Control Studio recommends PI for the heater, which is within 0.2 degrees Celsius of 38 from 19.1 seconds, and PID for the shaft, which settles within 0.02 radians at 3.12 seconds and returns under the 1.962 newton-metre load within 2.12 seconds.
svg.text: The recommended family for each process
Control Studio validation runs on the actual ST · the families it refused are explained in the text · numbers answer the predictions
PID recommended: within 0.02 rad from 3.12 s
Weight: lowest −0.080 rad, back within 0.02 rad at 2.12 s,
then held with 1.962 N·m at zero error
